name: nutri-heaven
description: Nutri Heaven — thin root scripts dispatching into the self-contained frontend/ and backend/ packages (each has its own lockfile; run pnpm install:all first)

scripts.install:all: pnpm -C frontend install && pnpm -C backend install
scripts.dev: pnpm -C frontend dev & pnpm -C backend dev & wait
scripts.build: pnpm -C backend build && pnpm -C frontend build
scripts.clean: pnpm -C backend clean && pnpm -C frontend clean
scripts.backend:seed: pnpm -C backend build && pnpm -C backend seed
